hook_types.name: Subvert-the-expected
hook_types.description: Names the expected reaction, then refuses it.
hook_types.example: We just closed a $12M oversubscribed seed round. The obvious thing to do today is post a thank-you note. Instead...

hook_types.name: Contrarian claim
hook_types.description: Challenges a common belief or industry hype head-on.
hook_types.example: If you're banking your entire product launch on a 1 million view viral moment, you've already lost.

hook_types.name: Vulnerability/pain confession
hook_types.description: Leads with honest operational difficulty rather than synthetic triumph.
hook_types.example: This was my fourth product launch. It doesn't get easier.

hook_types.name: Reframe
hook_types.description: Constructed around a sharp 'not X, it's Y' paradigm shift.
hook_types.example: The pivot isn't the detour. It's the point.

hook_types.name: Stakes-opener
hook_types.description: Bold declarative claim paired immediately with an operator credibility marker.
hook_types.example: Pivoting shamelessly is a rare founder advantage. I've been doing it for 6 years.

close_types.name: Declarative/stakes close
close_types.description: A definitive, high-conviction closing stance. Reads as a genuine opinion piece with zero explicit ask.
examples: Choose hard. You'll get a better result.
Everyone else will keep trying to scale outdated systems in a market that already moved on.

close_types.name: Engagement-bait question
close_types.description: Explicitly invites comments; reserved strictly for open-ended industry debates.
examples: Curious—what's the hardest pivot you've had to make?

middle_formats.name: Bulleted Takeaways
middle_formats.description: 2-3 crisp, high-signal takeaway bullets bridging the hook to the close.

middle_formats.name: Contrast Breakdown
middle_formats.description: Sharp wrong-way vs. right-way or expectation vs. production reality contrast.

middle_formats.name: Prose Reflection
middle_formats.description: 1-3 tight paragraphs of operator reflection without rigid templating.
